name: Eisenhower to Valley public-road alternative
evidence_note: Exact OSM endpoints 201217390/201217604. Service ways off Adelaide form a through connection to Valley; an ordinary-road witness via Hillside, Admiral Kalbfus, Miantonomi and Green End exists. Compare both under one model; low-speed service maneuvering should not win merely by saving metres. Preserve boundary detour and all source restrictions. Quality expectation: use the ordinary-road witness without service through-travel when adding at most 30% distance. This is a practical-routing criterion, not measured journey-time validation.
